Hi Priya — thanks for the details. A few technical notes and what we'll provide during the tests: 

SAML notes:
- ACS URL (test): https://f-api.redwood.ai/saml/acs/finCap
- EntityID (SP): https://redwood.ai/saml/sp/finCap
- Required attributes: email, firstName, lastName, employeeNumber (we can accept it as transient or persistent NameID if preferred)
- Signature: preference for HTTP-POST with signed assertions; we can accept SHA256.

SCIM provisioning:
- Supported attributes: userName, givenName, familyName, email, employeeNumber (externalId), costCenter, active
- Group sync: supported via group endpoint; we recommend starting with 1–2 pilot groups
- Provisioning behavior: create/update/deactivate; we will send provisioning logs to the shared drive and provide bulk reconciliation tools

Service accounts & roles:
- We'll create a scoped service account (redwood-fincap-provisioner) limited to provisioning and read-only org metadata calls.
- Keys: support for short-lived JWT-based creds or long-lived keys with enforced rotation (recommended 90 days).
- We will provide a sample terraform snippet for role bindings during the service account creation call.

Audit & evidence:
- Standard log retention: 6 months by default for hosted; SOC2 evidence exports available on request (we can provide a 12-month export for onboarding audit — creating JIRA ticket).
- I've opened JIRA ticket JIRA-SECQ-4923 to track the export and evidence delivery.

Next steps:
- I'll upload a sample SCIM mapping and our test SAML metadata to the shared drive (link below).
- Confirmed: we'll test connectivity from the staging ranges in fincap_firewall_ranges.txt before production.
